metaDescription: Own minerals near Myton, Utah, in the Monument Butte development area? Get a documented offer for your interest, priced against real production data.
heroLead: Myton sits close to the heavily developed Monument Butte field, where a dense grid of wells has produced steadily from shallow Green River sands for decades.
intro: Myton, in Duchesne County, sits near the southern edge of the Monument Butte field, one of the more densely drilled areas in the entire Uinta Basin. Unlike the deeper, fewer-but-larger wells of Altamont-Bluebell, Monument Butte development relied on a high density of shallower wells spaced closely together, which means mineral owners here often see their interest touched by multiple wells within a single spacing unit.

If you hold a mineral interest near Myton, we will confirm which of those wells your tract is actually pooled into before making an offer, since a unit with several producing wells can be valued differently than one with a single well.

sections.heading: Dense well spacing and pooled units
paragraphs: Monument Butte's development pattern means a given 40- or 80-acre tract near Myton may be pooled into a unit alongside several wells drilled over different years, each contributing its own share to your royalty. This can make a division order statement near Myton look more layered than a single-well interest elsewhere in the basin, but it generally works in the owner's favor — more wells producing into the same unit means a broader base of production supporting the royalty stream.

sections.heading: A mature field with a long track record
paragraphs: Monument Butte has been developed since the 1990s, giving owners near Myton a long track record to draw on when estimating remaining reserves and future decline. We use that history directly — trailing production, well count, and permitting activity in your specific unit — rather than a general estimate for the field as a whole.

sections.heading: What we need to get you a number
paragraphs: The fastest path to a written offer near Myton is a deed or division order with your legal description, though we can also work from an old royalty check stub if that is all you have. Once we match that to the current operator's records, we can typically turn around a written offer within a few business days.

faqs.question: My division order lists several wells for one interest. Is that normal near Myton?
faqs.answer: Yes, Monument Butte's dense well spacing means a single unit often includes multiple wells, and we account for all of them in our valuation.

faqs.question: Is Monument Butte still actively being drilled near Myton?
faqs.answer: Activity varies by section and operator. We check recent permitting near your specific tract before quoting.

faqs.question: Does a multi-well unit make my interest more valuable than a single-well unit elsewhere?
faqs.answer: It can, since a broader production base often supports steadier value, but we still confirm the specific numbers for your unit before making an offer.

faqs.question: How fast can I get a written offer?
faqs.answer: Once we have your legal description matched against operator records, we can typically turn around a written offer within a few business days.
